queries.query: Moro Sindh Pakistan cadastral map land records official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Board of Revenue Government of Sindh Sindh Zameen portal, its Deh Maps service, the official Sindh Deh list identifying Deh Moro in Naushahro Feroze Taluka Moro, and the official active-centres page identifying the N. Feroze land-record centre. The public map host was not available for a bounded anonymous parcel response.

queries.query: مورو سندھ پاکستان کادستر نقشہ زمین ریکارڈ سرکاری
queries.result: The native-language discovery also returned the official Sindh Zameen portal, which presents land-record and map services in Urdu and Sindhi and links to Deh Maps. No safe anonymous parcel ID plus full polygon response was obtained.

registryCustodian: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh, via the Sindh Zameen/LARMIS land-record portal and the N. Feroze district land-record centre serving the Moro taluka/deh context.

registryEvidence.interpretation: The first-party Sindh portal explicitly provides Deh Maps and land records; the official Deh list includes Moro under Naushahro Feroze district, Moro taluka; and the active-centres page lists the N. Feroze centre. This establishes a relevant registry/map custodian, not an open parcel-vector API or citywide geometry feed.

sourceReview.service: Sindh Zameen / LARMIS, Board of Revenue Government of Sindh
sourceReview.crs: unverified; no parcel geometry response obtained
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed

requestOutcomes.outcome: Anonymous TLS-verified direct request timed out after 20 seconds; no HTML, JavaScript/configuration, service route, schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry was obtained. TLS verification was not disabled.
Official Deh Maps host linked by the portal returned 502 Bad Gateway in the bounded fetch. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or TLS exception was attempted.

Official portal map page was reachable through public indexing and exposed a Deh Maps UI shell, but no parcel feature response, native ID field, CRS, or usable geometry was returned in the inspected response.
Official maps index exposed Deh Maps, General Maps, Archives, the Sindh Deh list, and map-fee information; it did not expose a bounded parcel-vector response.
Official Deh list result identifies Moro under Naushahro Feroze district and Moro taluka. This is administrative/deh coverage evidence, not parcel geometry or city-boundary evidence.
Official active-centres page lists the N. Feroze district land-record centre. Contact details were not retained.

Official FAQ states that Sindh land records include Village Forms II, VII-A, VII-B and Deh Maps, and that complete records are obtained through the relevant Peoples Service Center; it also describes limited public information for privacy. No parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against parcel geometry; the official map host did not return a usable anonymous parcel response. Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
